newsitem.title: USA: Circus Circus sees lower Q4 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Circus Circus sees lower Q4 earnings.

text.p: Circus Circus Enterprises Inc said Thursday it expects earnings in the fourth quarter to be below those of the year-ago period because of ongoing construction.
The gaming company said in a statement that extensive construction is going on at both Circus Circus-Las Vegas and Luxor, which are it's major profit producers.

This construction also dragged profits lower in its third quarter, the company said. Third quarter operating cash flow at Circus Circus-Las Vegas was about $8.5 million against $16.5 million in the year-ago quarter, and Luxor had about $14 million in operating cash flow against $23 million.

The company said that by December 24, construction on the 1,000-room tower at Circus Circus-Las Vegas should be completed, and nearly all the 2,000 new rooms at Luxor will be ready, along with casino and public area improvements.
Earlier Circus Circus reported third quarter profits of $34.8 million or $0.34 a share compared with $46.5 million or $0.45 a share in the year-ago period.

Circus Circus said its Excalibur resort in Las Vegas remained on course to a record year in operating cash flow while its new Monte Carlo, a joint venture with Mirage Resorts Inc continued to exceed expectations.
